public.title: Spreadsheet
public.description: input {cells,operations}; cells maps cell names to integers or {sum:[cell names]}. Operations are {op:"get",cell} or {op:"set",cell,value}. Missing cells evaluate to 0, sums may reference other cells, and dependency graphs are acyclic throughout. Set emits no output; get emits the recursively calculated integer. Return get results. At most 12 cells, 20 operations and 3 terms per sum; dependency depth at most 5. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Evaluate sum formulas recursively at each read, so later edits are visible. With branching b and depth h, a read costs O(b to the h) without memoization and O(h) recursion stack. Explicit cell/depth limits bound this small adapter. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
